headline: Last session: Sensex surged 1,718 points and Nifty reclaimed 25,000 as Indian markets logged biggest gains in seven months

marketStatus.message: Market is closed today because it is a weekend. It will reopen on Sunday, 8 November.

why: A sharp decline in global oil prices significantly improved domestic investor sentiment.
Strong foreign institutional investor (FII) flows into Indian equities drove the market rally.
Positive global cues from US markets and major Asian indices supported the domestic surge.
Robust buying in financial and auto sectors as the Samvat 2082 period concluded.
whatHappening: Sensex jumped 1,718 points to close at 81,028 while Nifty reclaimed the crucial 25,000 mark.
Nifty 50 ended the Samvat 2082 period on a high note, closing the session above 25,000.
The Enforcement Directorate is probing crypto exchanges CoinDCX and Delta Exchange over suspected illegal transactions.
The Centre mandated rice and paddy stock declarations to manage supply and control rising prices.
summary: Indian markets recorded their best performance in seven months during the last session, with the Sensex and Nifty surging nearly 2%. The rally was fueled by declining oil prices, strong foreign investment, and positive global cues. Trading is currently paused for the weekend and will resume on Sunday.
